name: dflash2-f16-medium
description: Medium reasoning, for the v0.3 live lane. The no-think configs measured the mechanical floor and neither completed a patch; the medium-reasoning AR run was the one that reached a compiling tree, which is why the live loop exists. Kept as a separate config rather than editing the no-think ones, so the closed one-shot experiment stays reproducible. Per-turn ceilings come from the lane's turn_limits, not from sampling.max_tokens.

identity_probe.note: STEP 0 OF docs/rig-campaign.md: identity_probe.require is deliberately empty. The rig fix that split AGENTBENCH_HEALTH_MODEL from the serve alias showed that /health reports a different model name than the name used to serve, so a require block guessed from the alias would abort every run. Inspect the real /health response, then put the value it actually reports here -- and, if the build exposes a field that distinguishes AR from DFlash, put that here too. That is what turns the row label from a claim into a checked fact.

experiment.notes: Live builder lane at medium reasoning. Not comparable with the no-think one-shot rows.
